body: Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-09 06:08Z; the second occurrence today). Implementers sometimes end a turn waiting for my wake without mailing me: their final text goes only to their own transcript. I wake only on mail, so the pair waits on each other. Today Opus3 sat idle about 45 min after its credited 1b check, and CSharpProof about 70 min after witness (c); earlier, CSharpProof waited about 44 min after its FAIL run. Practice: when an expected report is overdue past the step's normal length, do ONE read of termal_list_sessions (status and preview; this is a read, not polling), and wake any idle worker whose preview shows a finished step. Every wake I send asks the worker to mail me one line whenever it ends a turn waiting on me.
